defs.def: to look, smile, etc. in a particular direction 向 … 投以（视线、笑容等）
to make light, a shadow, etc. appear in a particular place 投射（光、影子等）

ex.s: She stopped thinking about the word “mile.” Instead, she focused on reaching the shadow cast on the track by an oak tree up ahead.
ex.t: 她不再去想"英里"这个词。相反，她专注于跑到前方一棵橡树投在跑道上的影子处。

ex.s: It was the most disastrous space accident ever, and it cast a shadow on people’s hearts.
ex.t: 那是史上最严重的太空事故，在人们心中投下了阴影。

defs.def: to say, do or suggest sth that makes people doubt sth or think that sb is less honest, good, etc. 使人怀疑；造谣中伤
to throw one end of a fishing line into a river, etc. 投（钓线）；抛（钓钩）

ex.s: They know not how to swim, They know not how to cast nets.
ex.t: 他们不知如何游泳，他们不知如何撒网。

ex.s: They seek not for hidden treasures, They know not how to cast nets.
ex.t: 他们不寻找隐藏的珍宝，他们不知如何撒网。

defs.def: to throw sb/sth somewhere, especially using force 扔；掷；抛
when a snake casts its skin, the skin comes off as part of a natural process （蛇）蜕（皮）
if a horse casts a shoe, the shoe comes off by accident （马）踢落（蹄铁）
to choose actors to play the different parts in a film/movie, play, etc; to choose an actor to play a particular role 分配角色；选派角色

ex.s: Photo E: You stand in front of , and it casts different shadows of you, in the rainbow.
ex.t: 照片E：你站在____前，它在彩虹中投下你不同的影子。

ex.s: Even now, to cast white actors as Asian characters is seen as acceptable by film studios.
ex.t: 即便现在，让白人演员饰演亚洲角色仍被电影制片厂视为可接受。

defs.def: to describe or present sb/yourself in a particular way 把某人描写成；把某人表现为
to vote for sb/sth 投票
to shape hot liquid metal, etc. by pouring it into a hollow container (called a mould ) 浇铸；铸造
to undo the ropes that are holding a boat in a fixed position, in order to sail away 解缆；解（船）；解缆出航
to remove stitches from the needles in a way that forms an edge that will not come undone 编织
all the people who act in a play or film/movie （一出戏剧或一部电影的）全体演员

ex.s: He was in the cast of “Tom Sawyer” when it was first performed and is a Children’s Theatre regular, with five shows to his credit.
ex.t: 他在《汤姆·索亚》首演时就在演员阵容中，是儿童剧院的常客，已参演五部剧。

defs.def: an object that is made by pouring hot liquid metal, etc. into a mould (= a specially shaped container) 铸件；铸造品
a shaped container used to make an object 模子；铸模
the way that a person or thing is or appears 特性；特征；外表；外貌
an act of throwing sth, especially a fishing line 投，掷，抛（钓线）
她的一条腿打上了石膏。
